title: Fix production /admin deep-link black screen and harden Admin Dashboard rendering

requirements.summary: Add static-hosting-safe deep-link support for /admin and normalize client routing so /admin, /admin/, and /admin/index.html all render the SPA Admin Panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening https://vpn-time-unlock.caffeine.xyz/admin in a fresh browser session loads the app UI (no platform placeholder/black screen).
Refreshing the page while on /admin continues to load the app and shows the Admin Panel route (not a 404/placeholder).
Navigation to /admin via the in-app button still works (History API navigation remains functional).

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated static entry HTML under /admin/ that bootstraps the same React SPA bundle as the root entry, so static hosts can serve the app when deep-linking to /admin without requiring server rewrites.

Harden pathname-based routing by normalizing admin paths so the Admin Panel renders for /admin, /admin/, and /admin/index.html (e.g., treat any path that begins with /admin as the admin route), while keeping existing History API navigation behavior intact.

requirements.summary: Ensure the Admin Panel reliably renders AdMob Settings and Users & Sessions Overview for admins, with explicit non-blank error states and retry affordances for all admin queries.
acceptanceCriteria: When logged in as an admin, the Admin Panel page visibly shows an “AdMob Settings” section with the two inputs and a working Save action.
When logged in as an admin, the Admin Panel page visibly shows a “Users & Sessions Overview” section with a table (or an explicit empty-state message when there is no data).
If admin status/overview/AdMob config queries error, the Admin Panel shows a readable error message in the page (not a blank screen), including a retry affordance (button or reload guidance).

file_operations.description: Add explicit in-page error handling for admin status, AdMob config, and overview loading (use the existing react-query hook states like isError/error and refetch), ensuring failures render readable alerts and a retry action instead of falling through to blank/incorrect states. Keep the existing AdMob Settings (App ID + Rewarded Ad Unit ID with Save) and Users & Sessions Overview sections visible for admins when data is available. Use the authorization component’s role-based access control via existing admin-check hooks to gate content appropriately. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
